clips.title: The story
paras: "At Home in the Shadows" is an introductory rogue quest on Zephras Isle. After aiding Rorian the Dayseeker in Thendal Grove, budding rogues are directed to read a summons and meet their local class mentor, Akeri Duskblade. The quest marks the moment young rogues transition from general village chores to serious stealth and combat training.

While handling basic threats around Thendal Grove, young rogues draw the attention of Akeri Duskblade, the grove's resident rogue trainer. Rather than mingling openly in the settlement, Akeri passes a simple note through Rorian the Dayseeker. Rorian recognizes that despite Akeri's suspicious demeanor, the mentor understands the practical skills needed to survive outside the grove's sheltered boundaries.

Tucked away inside the village watchtower, Akeri Duskblade wastes no time mincing words. He evaluates every newcomer's footing and awareness immediately upon their arrival, warning that sloppy footwork outside Thendal Grove leads straight to an early grave. By surviving Akeri's scrutiny, a rogue takes their first formal step into mastering stealth, precision, and survival on Zephras Isle.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident rogue trainer--Akeri Duskblade--has requested to speak with you. He left this note, so read that first, then seek him out inside the watchtower, here in the village.
He's a shady fellow, but then again, so are you. I think you'll get along well.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I almost did not hear you approach me, young rogue.

Almost won't be good enough when you leave Thendal Grove. You must be a slender blade, silent and steady. Ever vigilant and ever mindful of your surroundings. You might have what it takes to survive the dangers of Zephras. You also might end up with your throat slit in a ditch. Ultimately that's entirely up to you.
Speak with me again if you wish to take your next steps.
